value.title: RestApp route registration and routing policy interface

acceptanceCriteria.text: `RestApp` declares `get`, `post`, `put`, `patch`, `delete`, `head` and `options`, each taking `(String path, RouteHandler handler)` and returning `RestApp`. [D-040]
`RestApp` declares `route(Method, String, RouteHandler)` and `route(MethodSet, String, RouteHandler)` returning `RestApp`, and `route(String)` returning `RouteBuilder`. [D-041; D-043]

`RestApp` declares `routerPolicy(RouterPolicy)` returning `RestApp`, taking the existing `RouterPolicy` built with `RouterPolicy.builder()` (`mergeSlashes`, `ignoreTrailingSlash`, `caseInsensitive`, `enableTrace`, `enableConnect`). [D-393; D-398; wave decision: Remaining markers; wave-3 carried: routing-policy API names]
A reflection test finds no method named `serve` on `RestApp`. [D-046]

At the wave 3 merge, a reflection test finds that the methods of the public `RestApp` interface are exactly the route registration and routing policy methods above (no `ws`, `use` or `listen` until their waves add them; the internal WebSocket hook of FR-HTTP-008 is not on the interface); nullness follows the wave 1 convention: the package is `@NullMarked` (non-null by default, which counts as `@NonNull`) and any nullable reference-type parameter or return carries `@Nullable`, which the test checks through the package annotation and the `@Nullable` positions listed in `docs/api/app.md`. [D-393; D-072]
Kotlin source `app.get("/x") { req, res -> res.send("ok") }` compiles and returns `RestApp`. [D-040]

value.requirement: The system shall provide a public `RestApp` interface in `com.snoworca.naruserve` whose wave 3 methods are the route registration methods `get`, `post`, `put`, `patch`, `delete`, `head`, `options`, `route(Method, ...)`, `route(MethodSet, ...)` and `route(path)`, and the routing policy method `routerPolicy(RouterPolicy)`, with no `serve(...)` method.
value.rationale: Covers D-040, D-041, D-046, D-393 and D-398 (routing policy API name), the wave decision on remaining markers (`app.routerPolicy(RouterPolicy)`), and the carried item that the routing-policy configuration API names are decided in wave 3. Later waves add their own `RestApp` methods.
